base: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished, very calm panoramic illustration for a children's Gurbani learning app. Match the attached Pauri 1 visual reference: muted sage, ochre, powder-blue water, warm ivory sky, simple broad painted shapes, sparse detail, no outlines. Wide 3:1 panorama, a continuous sandy footpath and blue river connect 4 widely spaced landmarks LEFT TO RIGHT. Large readable silhouettes, empty sky top third, focal objects in lower-middle band, no collage panels. Keep landmarks distinct and evenly spaced so a phone can pan across them. This is a respectful mnemonic landscape, NOT a literal picture of God or the Guru, NOT a historical claim. No people, no deities, no faces, no sacred writing, no text, no logos, no UI, no coins or game rewards. Do not decorate the empty space. Maintain the same natural world from one scene to the next.
